answer: An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 4 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. The cipher counter is kept in inlet and horizon reveals each threshold crossing. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. Repeating the trick 8 times costs 29 separate deposits and 35 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
